rules.lossRule: close if spread debit reaches 2x the credit received or short strike is breached

rules.goalRealistic: 3-8% per month at 8-13% risk per trade; a single max-loss trade costs 8-13%, so two losers in a row is a 20%+ drawdown

rules.timingCheck: Added 9/15: before alerting, read the dashboard's projected next turn for the ticker (data.js outlook/nextReversal). If a lower low (for puts) or higher high (for calls) is projected within 2 trading days, alert with a resting GTC limit above the current mid and check the short strike keeps a 6% cushion below the projected low; else name the next-lower spread. method.quote: The app's primary focus was date and time. And then from that predict the price.
method.summary: Timing-led. Direction = the app's current leg (next projected turn LOW -> call credit spread; HIGH -> put credit spread). Expiry = first listed expiry >= 2 trading days after the turn, before earnings. Enter any day with >= 2 trading days left in the leg; exit at the projected turn or 50% of credit; stop 2x credit or short strike breached. Put short strike >= 3% below any projected low before expiry. Replaces the down-day/RSI triggers and the fixed 28-50 DTE window. Option-mechanics and sizing rules unchanged; TSLA bearish rule unchanged.
